title: kith-jmap: parse_request silently accepts any non-empty using array with no capability check
description: parse_request accepts any non-empty using array. The comment says 'unknown capabilities silently ignored for interoperability'. But urn:ietf:params:jmap:core is also never checked — a client that sends only an empty-string URI like [''] passes validation. RFC 8620 §3.3 says the server MUST return unknownCapability if the using array contains a URI that the server does not support — the RFC clearly says 'unknown URIs MUST be rejected'. The current implementation inverts this: it silently accepts unknown URIs instead of rejecting them. Tests explicitly assert this behavior (test_parse_request_unknown_capability_ignored) which means the tests would need to change too. This is a deliberate design choice with a comment defending it, but the comment misrepresents RFC 8620 §3.3. At minimum the comment should acknowledge the deviation; ideally file as a known RFC deviation in kith-architecture.md.
